chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
I am amazed at the one who abstains from food out of fear of illness; how does he not abstain from sins out of fear of the Fire?

key_terms.يَحْتَمِي: to abstain or protect oneself from something harmful
key_terms.ٱلطَّعَامِ: food, mentioned here as something avoided for bodily health
key_terms.ٱلنَّارِ: the Fire, meaning hellfire in the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: Why should a believer avoid sins as carefully as harmful food?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that people often take precautions against bodily harm while neglecting the far greater danger of sin and its consequences in the Hereafter. It calls the believer to avoid sins with the same seriousness and discipline used in protecting physical health.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4272 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"I am amazed at the one who abstains from food out of fear of illness, how does he not abstain from sins out of fear of the Fire?"
